name: UGC 12182, SN 2006fp field (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 12182, a galaxy that hosted the possible supernova impostor SN 2006fp, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2006fp-hubble
story: The flare cataloged as SN 2006fp may not have been a true supernova at all, but a violent outburst from a star. Hubble looked back at the site to test whether such supernova impostors survive their eruptions.

claims.text: It was more likely an outburst of a luminous blue variable than a true supernova
Hubble program 13029 tests whether SN impostors are LBV superoutbursts that survived
